question: In a row of girls facing North, Rimjhim is tenth to the left of Rakhi, who is seventeenth from the right end. Rajul is fourth to the right of Rimjhim. If Rajul is tenth from the left end, then how many girls are there in the row?
solution:
The logic follows here is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd16da1f1453d5e92e092a4b65c16939a322d13cc055a7f87777303f439044a5.png] 

**Total number of girls = 5 (Left of Rimjhim) + 1 (Rimjhim) + 9 (Between Rimjhim and Rakhi) + 1 (Rakhi) + 16 (Right of Rakhi)**
